text: dsh-open-card 是适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的客户端界面插件，通过悬浮控制条让用户点选页面中的面板或其他界面块，再拖动边框与角点调整宽高。它还支持移动选中块、置前、收起和展开、切换内部滚动、选择上层容器以及恢复原样；可拖动的悬浮球也能移动到不遮挡的位置。尺寸、位置和收起状态会按元素保存在浏览器中，并在页面刷新后尝试恢复。适合希望自行整理 DSH 网页面板布局、避免某个界面块遮挡会话列表或输入区的用户。源码未配置 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-open-card is a client plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Select an element and drag its edges to resize, move, raise, collapse or restore it. Layout and launcher positions persist in browser storage across reloads. It needs no API key or external service.
DSH 网页里的侧边面板太宽，能不能直接拖边框改小？
我想把挡住会话列表的浮层挪开，并在刷新后保留位置。
How can I collapse a crowded web panel and bring it back when I need it?
dsh-open-card 的功能「拖拽调整界面块」：点选页面中的元素后，可拖动八个边角控制点改变宽高，也可拖动整个元素改变位置；工具条还提供置前与恢复原样。调整结果按元素记入浏览器存储，页面重载时可重新应用。
dsh-open-card 的功能「收起与滚动面板」：选中界面块后可将其收起以腾出空间，再展开恢复；缩小内容时可以使用内部滚动查看，也能切换选择上层容器。状态会保存在浏览器中，便于刷新后恢复。
dsh-open-card 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-open-card README · 这是什么：`dsh-open-card` 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) Web UI 的一个客户端插件。它给页面上**任意**界面块加一层可拖拽的边框：点选之后拉边角改长宽，还能整体平移、置前、收起，尺寸记在浏览器里，刷新后自动恢复。

dsh-open-card README · 解决什么问题：第三方插件常常在自己的面板里塞满内容，把会话列表、输入区、工具栏挡住，而用户没法把它的尺寸改小——因为布局宽度由框架内部的 store 独占，插件之间也没有互相调整的公开接口。

这个插件不去猜别人的 DOM 结构，也不依赖任何插件的内部实现：**由用户点选目标块**，插件在改动前快照它原有的内联样式，再用内联样式直接写 `width` / `height` / `transform` / `z-index`。所以它对任何插件、任何面板都生效，并且随时可以一键还原。

dsh-open-card README · 功能：| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 点选块 | 鼠标移上去蓝框高亮，点一下选中；`Alt+R` 进入/退出点选模式 |
| 拖拽改尺寸 | 8 个方向控制点，任意拖长拖宽 |
| 收起 | 把块压成 0 高让出位置，块本身还在，随时展开 |
| 滚动模式 | 块缩小后内容保持原大小、改为内部滚动，不被压扁截断（缩到 50% 以下自动开启） |
| 上溯一层 | 点选常落在最内层的小 span 上，一键选中包含它的容器 |
| 平移 | 按住整体拖动，位置也一起记住 |
| 置前 | 提到最前，避免被别的浮层盖住 |
| 复位 | 这一块还原成插件改动前的样子 |
| 记忆 | 尺寸、位置、收起/滚动状态按元素持久化在 `localStorage`，刷新后自动重建 |
| 可拖动悬浮球 | 悬浮球本身位置也可拖动并记忆，拖到边缘自动收进视口 |

dsh-open-card README · 用法：1. 点右下角悬浮球，或按 `Alt+R`。
2. 鼠标移到要调整的块上，蓝框出现后点一下。
3. 拖 8 个控制点改长宽；顶部工具条给出收起、滚动、上溯、复位、置前、移动、取消。
4. `Esc` 退出点选或取消选中。

dsh-open-card README · 存储：- `dsh-open-card.sizes.v1` — 每个元素的尺寸/位置/收起/滚动状态，键是元素选择器（锚定最近的 `id` 或 `data-slot`）。
- `dsh-open-card.dock.v1` — 悬浮球位置。
- 从旧名 `dsh-resizer` 升级时会自动读取旧键，不丢配置。

dsh-open-card README · 实现说明：`ctx.layout` 只暴露导航与面板选择（`selectPanel` / `toggleSidebar` / `openRightbar` / `closeRightbar`），没有改列宽的入口——三列宽度由 `AppFrame` 内部 store 独占。因此本插件不触碰框架布局，而是作用于用户选中的具体元素。

同时，`shell.overlay` 自带 `z-index: 20` 的层叠上下文，挂在那里永远压不过鲸鱼挂件一类的高 z-index 浮层；所以整个 UI 用 `ReactDOM.createPortal` 挂到 `document.body`，自己开一层 `z-index: 2147483000`。
dsh-open-card README · 图标：插件标识与「列表 / 边框笔」图标由本项目作者提供；工具条其余六枚取自 [Bootstrap Icons](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/)（MIT），统一为 `currentColor` 单色。

dsh-open-card README · What it is：`dsh-open-card` is a client-side plugin for the **DeepSeek Harness** Web UI. It puts a draggable frame around *any* panel on the page: click a block, drag its borders to resize it, then move it, raise it, or collapse it entirely. Sizes are stored in the browser and restored on reload.

dsh-open-card README · The problem it solves：Third-party plugins often fill their own panel with content that covers your conversation list, composer, or toolbar — and you cannot shrink them, because column widths are owned by an internal layout store and plugins expose no API to resize one another.

dsh-open-card README · The problem it solves：Instead of guessing at other plugins' DOM structure, this plugin lets **you pick the block**. It snapshots the block's existing inline style, then writes `width` / `height` / `transform` / `z-index` directly. It therefore works on any panel from any plugin, and every change can be undone with one click.

dsh-open-card README · Features：| Capability | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Pick a block | Hovering outlines the block in blue; click to select. `Alt+R` toggles pick mode |
| Drag to resize | Eight handles — drag any border or corner |
| Collapse | Squash the block to zero height to free the space it covers; the block stays alive and can be expanded again |
| Scroll mode | When a block is shrunk, its content keeps its natural size and scrolls internally instead of being squeezed (auto-enabled below 50%) |
| Select parent | Picking often lands on a tiny inner `span`; jump to the containing container in one click |
| Move | Drag the whole block; its offset is remembered too |
| Raise | Bring the block to the front so other overlays cannot cover it |
| Reset | Restore this block to exactly how it looked before the plugin touched it |
| Persistence | Size, offset, collapsed and scrolling state are persisted per element in `localStorage` and re-applied on reload |
| Draggable launcher | The floating launcher can itself be dragged and remembers its position, and is nudged back inside the viewport at the edges |
dsh-open-card README · Install：```bash
dsh-open-card README · 1. Put this repository anywhere, e.g.：git clone https://github.com/<you>/dsh-open-card.git

dsh-open-card README · (call plugin_manager in a DSH session, or use "install local bundle" in the plugins page)：plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<absolute-path>/dsh-open-card" })
```

Reload the page afterwards; the launcher appears in the bottom-right corner.

text:
dsh-open-card README · Usage：1. Click the launcher in the bottom-right corner, or press `Alt+R`.
2. Hover the block you want to resize; when the blue outline appears, click it.
3. Drag any of the eight handles. The floating toolbar offers collapse, scroll, select-parent, reset, raise, move and deselect.
4. `Esc` leaves pick mode or clears the selection.

dsh-open-card README · Storage：- `dsh-open-card.sizes.v1` — per-element size/offset/collapsed/scrolling state, keyed by a CSS selector anchored on the nearest `id` or `data-slot`.
- `dsh-open-card.dock.v1` — launcher position.
- Upgrading from the previous name `dsh-resizer` reads the old keys, so nothing is lost.

dsh-open-card README · Implementation notes：`ctx.layout` only exposes navigation and panel selection (`selectPanel` / `toggleSidebar` / `openRightbar` / `closeRightbar`); there is no API for setting column widths, because the three-column widths are owned by the internal `AppFrame` store. This plugin therefore never touches the framework layout — it only affects the specific element you pick.

dsh-open-card README · Implementation notes：Also, `shell.overlay` establishes a stacking context at `z-index: 20`, so anything mounted there stays below high-z-index overlays such as floating widgets. The whole UI is mounted on `document.body` through `ReactDOM.createPortal` inside its own layer at `z-index: 2147483000`.

dsh-open-card README · Icons：The plugin identity icon and the list / border-pen icons are provided by the project author; the remaining six toolbar icons come from [Bootstrap Icons](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/) (MIT) and are rendered as single-colour `currentColor` glyphs.
